name: Ballistics Specialist Request
description: The ballistics specialist requires a precision bow platform beyond standard issue. Help craft the Moonlit Bow prototype.

text: Seeker! I need a bow frame made from Moonwood composite.
Will you aid me in this endeavor?
completedText: Seek the Moonwood Scrap in the Midnight Salvage Yard.
Return to the Bowmaster with the Moonwood.

hasItemText: Ah, perfect! With this, I can teach you to craft the Moonlit Bow.

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You've been awarded @crimson@2500 Fletching experience@green@ and the @crimson@Moonlit Bow Blueprint@green@.
